origine_fr: Un cochon 豕 sous un toit 宀 : on l'écrit ainsi depuis plus de 3 000 ans. Le toit et la bête de la maison disent le foyer, puis la famille. Une vieille explication voit dans 豕 le verrat 豭, lu jiā, qui donnerait le son.
origine_en: A pig 豕 under a roof 宀: it was already written this way over 3,000 years ago. The roof and the household animal stand for home, then family. An old explanation says 豕 is short for 豭, a boar, read jiā, which would give the sound.

phrase.pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
phrase.en: How many people are there in your family?
